body:
Smokin' Shroomz??
Being one who decided to grow some mushrooms I started reading about people smoking them but I had never tried it.  Until now, let me tell you that there is definitaly an from the shrooms.   I smoked it with a very small amount of weed in the bowls as one thing I read before was it tasted horrible.  I'll describe the setting and time frame of the effects.
9:00pm  -  Smoked 3 bowls (1 g) mushrooms, sitting in my room which is fairly big in size as I have a queen size bed, punching bag, big closet and a stereo system with 4 nice speakers, dvd player etc.
9:15pm  -  Listening to sean paul and 8 mile soundtrack.
NOTE***I always listen to music for a while usually just switch between the discs (5 disc)***
11:00  -  I am feeling relaxed and definitely could fell something from the mushrooms.  Then I was sitting looking at the 5 lights for each disc as some music was playing (8 mile soundtrack) and they started spinning for a second but then stopped. kinda weird and not from the weed.
now it is 11:58pm but I feel like it should be like 2am, just listening to the end of the football game and can still feel something in my body, real relaxing.
